title: The Vehicle Return Option Under the Kestrel Advantage Balloon Contract
content:
**1. The return.** Returning the vehicle under a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract is the customer's own act at a Kestrel dealer, who records the odometer and signs the vehicle in.

**2. When a return is allowed.** The vehicle may be returned only when the contract records the return option as available, the contract is 0 days past due apart from the balloon installment itself, and the return date is no earlier than the tier's return-window days in calendar days before the maturity date.

**3. Return deadline.** The vehicle must be returned no later than the tier's return grace days after the balloon payment fell due. The period is counted in calendar days starting the day after the maturity date, and a return on the last day is timely.

**4. Balance.** On return the balloon balance is satisfied by the vehicle, so the remaining principal balance is credited out; every regular installment must already be paid.

**5. Inspection.** The return inspection records the odometer and the excess wear assessed under the Kestrel wear standard.

**6. Excess miles.** Excess miles are the inspection odometer less the odometer at contract less the annual mileage allowance times the term in months divided by 12, never below zero, and are charged at the tier's excess mileage rate per mile, rounded to the cent. *This clause is no longer in force for the excess mileage charge billed on a returned balloon contract of a customer who holds at most one active Kestrel lease and at most one active Kestrel new-vehicle retail contract, and is superseded by the current basis for that charge; for a customer holding two or more active Kestrel leases or two or more active Kestrel new-vehicle retail contracts it continues to govern the excess mileage charge.*

**7. Excess wear.** The excess wear charge is the wear assessed less the tier's wear waiver cap, never below zero. *This clause is no longer in force for the excess wear charge billed on a returned balloon contract of a customer who holds at most one active Kestrel lease, at most one active Kestrel new-vehicle retail contract and at most one Kestrel new-vehicle retail contract at paid in full or closed, and is superseded by the current basis for that charge; for a customer holding two or more of any of those it continues to govern the excess wear charge.*

**8. Return fee.** The return fee is the tier's return fee, waived when the customer signs a new Kestrel retail contract or lease within the tier's loyalty days in calendar days before or after the return date. *This clause is no longer in force for the return fee billed on a returned balloon contract of a customer who holds at most one active Kestrel lease, at most one active Kestrel new-vehicle retail contract and at most one active Kestrel pre-owned retail contract, and is superseded by the current basis for that fee; for a customer holding two or more of any of those it continues to govern the return fee.*

**9. Billing status.** Return charges can be billed only while the contract status is returned.

**10. Dispute period.** Return charges may be billed only after the tier's dispute days have fully elapsed from the date the vehicle was returned. The dispute period is counted in calendar days starting the day after the return date, so billing is permitted from the calendar day after the return date plus the dispute days. A dispute filed within the dispute period is resolved before billing.

**11. Due date, closing and charge-off.** Charges are due the tier's charges-due days in calendar days after billing. *This sentence is no longer in force for return charges placed on a return balance plan, and is superseded by the current basis for those charges; return charges not placed on a plan stay due that many calendar days after billing.* The account closes when the charges are paid, and charges still unpaid the tier's charge-off days after the return are charged off.

## Boundaries (hypothetical)

| Rule | Anchor | Last or first permitted day |
|---|---|---|
| Return deadline (10 grace days) | Maturity on the 5th | Return on the 15th is timely; the 16th is late |
| Dispute period (14 days) | Return on the 1st | Billing on the 15th is not permitted; billing from the 16th is |
| Return window (30 days before maturity) | Maturity on the 31st of a month | A return on the 1st of that month is within the window; earlier is not |
